column2: NStrihash (UE2 appStrihash; regcheck refuses a hook: partial cx): its nine callers are hooked (NMsnHeaderMap::Rehash/Lookup, NMsnStrStrMap::Add/Set, TMapFStringWnd::Rehash, NMsnWndStrMapOps::MultiFind/AddWnd, NMsnWndStrMap::FindWnd/SetWnd) and call NChatTypes.cpp's NStrihash; no vtable or pointer refers to it
Md5::CopyWords (eax/ecx/edx arguments; regcheck refuses a hook): its two callers are the two Md5::Final call sites; Final 10127080 is hooked (NMd5Final copies with memcpy)
Md5::DecodeWords (eax/ecx/edx arguments; regcheck refuses a hook): its only caller is Md5::Transform, itself dead; NMd5Transform reads the block's words in C++

Md5::Transform (eax/stack arguments; regcheck refuses a hook): its two callers are the two block calls of Md5::Update 10126FC0, which is hooked (NMd5Update runs the C++ NMd5Transform, native-tested against RFC 1321)

HasNoFinalConsonant (character in AX; regcheck refuses a hook): its three callers (NConsoleWnd::FormatSystemMessage, EndSystemMessageParam, MakeSystemMessage) are hooked and carry the logic inline (NConsoleWnd.h)
